status: Private execution contract recorded before evaluation; no physical/provider/public/owner admission
ownership: The existing runtime observation coordinator owns one sealed immutable epoch-domain token. Each actual CaptureKey retains that token; Windows adapters retain their actual coordinator's token before launch and through startup reconciliation. Owned frames and composite identity observations preserve the actual token. No new host role/channel, public command, serialization ABI or product composition.
domain: Token construction is private to ObservationCapture. The coordinator and token cannot be copied or moved into independent counter streams. A retained token outlives its coordinator for historical evidence. A bounded nonzero process-local ordinal labels the token for explanation/hashing; it is not globally unique, durable, physical identity, a reconnect cursor or reconstructible authority. Overflow refuses construction. No OS query, file, network or privilege is introduced.
guards: Actual key equality requires the same non-forged typed token as well as source/capture/worker. The existing update/failure/timeout/finish/retirement guards reject foreign or missing domains without changing state, graph, sequence, notices or outstanding ownership. Matching or advancing numeric counters across coordinators do not establish continuity. Native storage and namespace graph projections preserve the token separately from serialized observation data. Foreign typed graph content under a valid local key follows the existing malformed-result path without retiring that reader; pure JSON fixtures do not acquire typed ownership. Existing same-coordinator publication, stale-result handling, allocation atomicity and retirement behavior remain.
identity: Only an actual owned /2 frame carries its real key domain into immutable composite identity. Bind its explanatory local domain label along with complete frame/context and counter identities; preserve the typed token separately. Comparison requires identical retained domain objects before applying source/capture/worker ordering and selected-report quality. Missing, foreign or merely serialized labels cannot construct that token or authorize comparison. The owned ordinary-image/raw-layout wrapper also requires its actual storage key domain; the pure fixture comparison remains unauthenticated and does not acquire typed authority. Historical evidence and unknown physical association/freshness remain unchanged.
test_bridge: Only the existing compiled native reducer probe maps an exact previously issued test key (including its domain label) back to that retained typed key. JSON never creates a runtime token. Unissued, forged and domain-less key records remain unbound. The harness retains at most 8192 issued test keys and explicitly refuses exhaustion. This is a fixture harness, not a public authentication or execution mechanism.
required_checks: Actual separately created coordinators with equal source/capture/worker values have different typed domains; every guarded reducer path rejects the foreign key and preserves exact state/outstanding ownership.

Reset/reinitialize cannot reuse a historical key; missing and forged domain labels cannot select a valid issued test key. Same-coordinator keys remain usable after capture advance only for the specified actual retirement path.

Direct native type checks prohibit coordinator/token copying/moving. Retained historical views/keys/identity values preserve their domain after owner destruction without creating a new stream or admission claim.

Actual owned /2 readers from separate coordinators with otherwise permitted source/epoch values cannot compare, including when the later domain's worker counter advances. Same-domain comparisons and all existing weak/collision/conflict/byte-preservation cases retain their expected outcomes.
Owned snapshots reject a foreign expected typed key even if numeric fields match. Derivation/comparison remain pure; live publication does not retire a reader.

Clean Windows x64/Win32 native builds, fresh product build/launch and all relevant native regression groups, exact source/blob/byte bindings, toolchain/PE/import observations, tooling/context/manifest checks and durable partial handoff. Other hosts/historical Windows/live/physical/provider/public/owner admission remain separate.

A separately compiled boundary probe seeds the actual runtime ordinal counter at u64 maximum and proves repeated constructor refusal without an object or grant; normal product compilation does not enable the exhaustion define. Invalid private probe arguments produce no output.
limits: Existing source/attempt/frame/graph/reader/parent/display budgets and native wait budgets remain unchanged. The domain token adds bounded internal ownership metadata; no truncation or widened wire budget.
